title: Cyrus and the Contact
author: Ansel Galloway
blurb: August Galloway, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
